<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Greater Hell Hound](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3048)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Believed to be bred by the Kings of Hell themselves within vast kennels, greater hell hounds are the favored guards and hunting hounds of powerful fiends and, rarely, mortals who worship them and have earned their favor.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 26

**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 26

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 9">[Greater Hell Hound](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3048)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=547" />
<trait label="Fiend" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=600" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=604" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 194

**Perception** +19; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet

**Languages**
[Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117); (can't speak any language)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +18, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +19, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +18, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +20

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +5

**Con** +5

**Int** -2

**Wis** +4

**Cha** -2
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 28 

**Fort** +21 

**Ref** +19 

**Will** +16 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 150

</row>

**Immunities**
[fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604)

**Weaknesses**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 10

**Hellish Revenge** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** The greater hell hound is critically hit by any Strike; **Effect** The greater hell hound's Hellfire Breath recharges. They can immediately use it as part of this reaction.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +21 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 2d8+9 piercing plus 2d6 fire

**Hellfire Breath** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) The hell hound breathes flames that deal 10d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone (DC 28 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save.) The hell hound can't use Hellfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds. If the greater hell hound would take fire damage or be targeted by a [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) effect, their Hellfire Breath recharges.

**Pack Attack**   The greater hell hound's Strikes deal 1d8 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of their allies.

</column>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Hell Hound Minions</title>

Outside of [Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42), hell hounds are sometimes found in the service of fire-loving monsters such as [fire giants](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3014) or [ifrit](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3006), as well as mortals who seek to tame some of the raw power of Hell. In Cheliax, Hellknights occasionally call upon hell hounds to track down fugitives and traitors.
</aside>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-427" />
name: Greater Hell Hound
